caption: M2 Money Supply (YoY growth) (vermillion, left axis) against the SPY price (blue, right axis), 1993–2026. The 2020-21 surge near 27% and the first-ever year-over-year contraction in 2022-23 are the vivid but regime-concentrated episodes. The tradable rule actually trades on the month-to-month CHANGE in this YoY rate (money-growth acceleration), not the level shown here. Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
narrative_alignment_note: Hero shows the vivid M2 YoY history with the 0% line and the surge/contraction episodes; caption clarifies the winner trades the acceleration transform, not this level.
